title: PSYCOGRAPHY -- performance panel: click track + 9-channel playback, synced

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Opens in presentation mode as the performance panel. Cmd+E shows the full wiring.
DSP toggle: turns audio on and off.
GO: starts the next section. Click sections run and stop by themselves at the next free section.
In a free section the clock waits; press GO again when the conductor moves on.
STOP: halts the transport. RESET: returns the cue list to the start.
start @ measure (rehearsal): type a measure number to jump click and audio there and start.
BAR : BEAT shows the live position; section shows number, start measure, type and total.
master sample: the clock position in samples.
PROGRAM VOICE METERS: the 9 playback slots. Use each slot's read button to load its WAV.

sections.heading: INPUTS & OUTPUTS
lines: Outputs 1-9: the nine mono program files. Output 10: the click, for the monitor mix.
Inputs 1-10: mic channels with meters and an empty insert slot per mic (mics tile).

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: transport runs one master sample clock (send~ master); click and playback both read from it.
Jumping to a measure just moves that clock, so click and audio land together.
cues steps through psycography_sections.txt (start measure + click/free per section).
The click is generated from the MIDI tempo map: accent, beat and subdivision.
Edit psycography_sections.txt with the real sections before a rehearsal.
